XU4 Legacy Edition is a fork of [XU4](https://xu4.sourceforge.net/) that
makes Ultima IV easier to play on modern systems, especially with the free
[GOG](https://www.gog.com/en/game/ultima_iv_quest_of_the_avatar) release.

## New in 1.3-pre1

A pre-release for testing.  Most of what is new is optional: the new
options are in Settings, Legacy Edition Options, More Options (now three
pages), and How to Play lists them all.

Help and books:

- **Tips**: a book of pointers on talking, virtue, food, healing,
  magic, dungeons and what to do when stuck, in the game menu.
- **Spoiler Guide** (off at first): turn it on to add the Guide, a
  walkthrough of the whole quest, to the Books of Britannia.
- **Journal**: the places found with how many of their clues were
  heard, the clues by topic, and View on the World Map; Journal Hints
  name who still knows more.
- **Combat Tips** in the first fights, and a description of each option
  in Settings.

Playing:

- **Party wipe**: the choice now offers the last save, an earlier save
  or Lord British's aid.  Load a Save is in the game menu.
- **Ask Rules At New Game**: Story, Modern or Classic after choosing
  Male or Female.  In Modern and Story a sleeper hit in a fight may
  wake.
- **Snap Attacks**: X (or Strike in the action menu) hits a foe in
  reach without aiming; Snap Target Mark shows which foe, and PgUp/PgDn
  or the shoulder buttons pick another.
- **Auto Combat**: any key takes the battle back, it stops when someone
  is badly hurt or no foe is hurt for 30 turns, and it can be turned on
  for one battle from the fight menu.
- **Step Onto To Use** (off at first): with Walk Into To Act, a chest
  or ladder stepped onto offers to be used.
- **Quick Mixing**: a spell mixed before can be made again by recipe.
- **Say What Blocks**: "Blocked by water!" in place of "Blocked!".
- **Action menu**: torches, gems and keys left; a torch or Light first
  in a dark dungeon; Steal Chest named in towns; each member's
  experience against the next level.
- **Settings Per Character**: with Keep Characters, each character keeps
  their own play options.
- **Steam Cloud Saves**: with the Steam release's game files, saves also
  go to its folder for Steam Cloud (Rules & Saving).
- New Word cheat (Ctrl-C N).

Shops and spells:

- **Shops Compare Arms** shows a panel, member by member; **Shop Buyer
  First** asks who is buying and greys what they cannot use; **Grey Wares
  Too Dear** greys what the gold cannot buy; **Shop Dials Stop At Gold**
  stops the dials at what the party can afford and shows the cost.
- **Spell Info In Lists** shows what the spell under the cursor does,
  costs and is mixed from; **Spell Card Extras** add mana beside each
  caster, castable spells first and the mixtures made.

Maps and screen:

- **Heard-Of Places On Map**: the world map names the places visited
  (yellow) and those named in conversation (grey, boxed where not yet
  explored).
- **Map Opens Where You Are**: in a town, castle, shrine or dungeon the
  map shows that place first.
- **Moongates Say Where**: a gate names the town it led to last.
- **Creatures On Mini Map** in dungeons.
- **Smooth Motion** (Video Options): the map slides and everyone glides
  from square to square.
- **Party Colours**: names coloured by state, hit points by how low they
  are.
- **Frame Colour By Place**: the border turns gold at a shrine and grey
  in a dungeon.
- **Effects Don't Stop Play**: spell flashes are brief while the sound
  plays on.
- **Fold Repeated Moves** also folds Blocked!, Slow progress! and Pass.

Input and system:

- **Held Key Pace** (Input Options) and **Stop At New Scene** (Keyboard
  Options): held keys repeat at a steady pace and stop at a fight, a new
  map or a moongate.
- **Update Notice**: release builds on Windows, macOS, Linux and Android
  check once a day for a newer release and offer its download page
  (not the Flatpak, which updates itself).
- Web and Android: Import Saves, and an error box with Copy Details (on
  Windows too).

## New in 1.2

New platforms:

- **macOS**: a universal app (Apple Silicon and Intel, macOS 11 or
  later) in `xu4-legacy-*-macos.dmg`.  See Getting started (macOS).
- **Android**: an APK for phones, tablets and handhelds (Android 7 or
  later), played with touch or a gamepad.  It takes the GOG game's
  folder (copied from a PC), its files or a zip of them, and the Files
  button of Graphics & Music lists, adds and removes game files.  See
  Getting started (Android).
- **Web, iPhone and iPad**: the game runs in the browser at
  <https://alexdia25.github.io/xu4-legacy-edition/play/>; on iOS use
  Safari's Share > Add to Home Screen to install it.  It takes the
  files of the installed GOG game (a folder, the files or a zip of
  them).  The Files button lists the game files kept in the browser,
  adds more (the VGA upgrade, disk images, the SMS ROM, the documents;
  loose or zipped) and removes them, and exports the saves.
- **Steam Deck**: the Flatpak can be installed with one click from the
  [Flatpak repository](https://alexdia25.github.io/xu4-legacy-edition/)
  and then updates with your other Flatpaks; the README has the steps
  for adding it to Steam.
- Android and web play fill the screen (stretched to fit, refitted when
  the device turns or the window is resized).

Finding the game:

- **The Steam release** of Ultima IV is found by itself in any Steam
  library, on Windows and on Linux or a Steam Deck (installed through
  Proton; the Flatpak can read Steam's folders).
- **Zip files of any name and layout**: the DOS game is found in any
  zip (such as `Ultima_IV_-_Quest_of_the_Avatar_1985.zip`, with the game
  in a folder), together with the History, Wisdom, Hints and Keyboard
  documents and a copy with the VGA upgrade installed if the zip has
  one.  Apple II and C64 disk images, the Master System ROM and
  `u4upgrad.zip` are taken out of any zip put with the game files (for
  example one zip holding them all), on every platform.

In the game:

- **Game menu**: Escape (Select) opens a menu drawn like the title
  menus, with the Journal, How to Play, the Books of Britannia, the
  World Map, Save Game, Settings, Graphics & Music and Quit Game.
- **The world map in play shows only what the party has explored**, so
  a Gem still has its use.  The Books of Britannia have a Map tab with
  the whole cloth map (without the party or the moongates), and the
  Cheats menu can map all of Britannia.  Games saved before 1.2 show the
  whole map.
- **Journal** of the virtues, quest items and clues heard, and a
  **dungeon auto-map** (mini map or top-down view of the rooms seen).
- **Legacy Edition options** (Settings): difficulty presets and rule
  toggles, auto combat, gear compare and equip on buy, spells named by
  effect and a heal shortcut, walk into to act, folded repeated moves,
  pause on focus loss, cheats, autosave with save history, several
  characters, a choice after a party wipe, scanlines and a battery
  saver.  They start on, except Walk Into To Act and Auto Combat, and
  under Rules, Saving & Cheats, Autosave, Keep Characters and the
  Cheats menu.  Console (SMS) Menus is now in Legacy Edition Options,
  and Pause Unfocused in the Graphics options.
- **Moon Speed** (Settings > Speed Options) slows the moons and their
  moongates to a half, a quarter or an eighth of the original speed,
  or speeds them up two, three (about the Master System's pace) or four
  times.  Normal keeps XU4's pace, close to the DOS game's: the moons
  turn in real time, a phase of Felucca every 4 seconds on the world
  map.
- **Map View** (Settings > Video > Game Graphics Options): Fill Space
  shows more of the towns, castles and Britannia when the tiles are
  smaller than the DOS ones.  With the SMS module's 12 pixel tiles the
  map holds 15 by 15 tiles instead of 11 by 11 in a black border.
  Combat and other small maps keep their size.
- With console menus, **meditating at a shrine picks the virtue from a
  list**, and **a barkeep is asked about a topic picked from a list**
  of those heard in conversation (the right pub must still be found).
  The Guild shops list the Sextant once the Britain pub has told the
  party about it, as in the Master System version (with the keyboard
  menus it stays the DOS game's secret item D).
- The books are read a chapter at a time in three text sizes, the
  History is offered when the story asks you to read it, and with Spell
  Info In Lists on, a spell or reagent opens its Book of Mystic Wisdom
  page (?, the right shoulder button, a right click or a long press).
  The Book of Mystic Wisdom is split into its entries from GOG's
  `ULTIMA4.TXT` and from the separate `Wisdom.txt` of other releases.
- Picking other graphics during play no longer goes back to the title:
  the game carries on where it was with the new graphics (in a town or a
  battle, once the party is back outside).  Your save files are not
  changed.

Controls:

- **Gamepad Buttons** (Settings > Input Options) sets what each button
  does in play.  The default is the 1.1.5 layout: A opens the action
  menu, B backs out of questions, X passes a turn, Y shows Ztats, L the
  world map and R does the obvious action (XU4's smart Enter); the
  Classic and Smart Enter layouts are one choice away.  A gamepad
  always gets the console menus and the letter grid.
- On the keyboard, Enter does the obvious action (XU4's smart Enter
  key) and Tab opens the action menu.
- With touch, tapping the party does the obvious action (the message
  area opens the action menu), Male or Female and the History's Yes or
  No are picked from short lists, and the books scroll by dragging.
- The help lines of the books, the world map and Graphics & Music name
  the gamepad buttons or the keys, whichever was used last.
- Names can be entered in upper and lower case with the letter grid.

Other changes and fixes:

- Graphics & Music is also in Configure; during play its first button
  is Apply.  About and Graphics & Music show the Legacy Edition version.
- The runes of the world map and Runes tab show in the browser.
- The text size buttons of the reader change only the text, and the
  U4-Upgrade font is drawn with its shading on the menu pages.
- A fatal error (such as missing game files) is shown in a message box
  on macOS and Linux too.
- Fixed: in Magincia, asking Nate the Snake about the Rune now opens
  the Rune with Barren in Paws, as Nate says.  The Master System
  version opened it when Nate was asked about the Stone instead.
- Fixed: the game could start small in a corner of the screen, partly
  cut off, when the system gave the window another size (filling the
  screen, high DPI scaling).  It is now fitted and centered in the window
  whatever its size, and the window is larger on Windows screens scaled
  to 175% or more.
- Fixed: on Android, pieces of menus were left in the black borders
  beside the game; the game also keeps clear of camera cutouts.

## New in 1.1.5

- **Talk menu**: topics now unlock by the Sega Master System rules for
  each person, so a topic opens only after the right answer, topic or
  hint (for example Joe's Stones only after answering yes, and the Rune
  chain in Trinsic).  Hints from other people and the pub rumors are
  saved with the game.
- Questions the SMS answers with a list (Swindrik's reagent and others)
  show the list, and the Ankh of Spirituality asks for its mantra.

## New in 1.1


Since 1.0:

- **World map** of Britannia drawn with the chosen module's tiles, with
  the cloth map's place names in runes or English, the moon phases at
  the moongates and the party's position marked (World Map in the
  Escape menu, Map in the xu4 menu, or View Map in the action menu).
- **Runes tab** in the Docs reader: the rune for each letter and the
  combined runes, and the virtues and some place names in runes.
- **Commodore 64 and Sega Master System graphics & music** modules,
  read from your own disk image or ROM, plus C64-Remastered.
- **Mouse-only and touch play**: move, open menus, pick items, answer
  the gypsy and flee from combat with taps alone; a menu icon in the
  corner opens the xu4 menu, and Settings can be changed during play.
- **Gamepad**: Talk comes first in the action menu when someone is in
  reach, and the menu has a Quit entry.
- A Tile Backgrounds option (Transparent or DOS Black), and a wider
  module browser using one font for all module names.
- SDL3 is now the only platform library (audio, PNG loading, video and
  input), replacing Faun, libpng and the old backends.  The 48 kHz
  sounds now play at the right speed.

## Getting started (Windows)

1. Install Ultima IV from GOG (free), or have the DOS game files ready.
2. Unzip `xu4-legacy-*-windows.zip` anywhere and run `xu4.exe`.

The game files are found automatically in `C:\GOG Games\Ultima 4 - Quest of
the Avatar`.  Otherwise put them (or `ultima4.zip`) next to `xu4.exe`, or in
`%LOCALAPPDATA%\xu4`.

## Getting started (macOS)

1. Open `xu4-legacy-*-macos.dmg` and drag XU4 Legacy to Applications.
2. Put the DOS game files (or `ultima4.zip`) in
   `~/Library/Application Support/xu4` (Finder: Go > Go to Folder).
3. The app is not signed by an Apple developer, so the first launch is
   refused: open System Settings > Privacy & Security and click Open
   Anyway beside XU4 Legacy.  Or once in Terminal:
   `xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine "/Applications/XU4 Legacy.app"`

## Getting started (Android)

1. Download `xu4-legacy-*-android.apk` on the device and open it (Android
   asks once to allow installs from the browser or file manager).
2. GOG's Ultima IV is a Windows installer: install it on a PC and copy
   the folder it made (`C:\GOG Games\Ultima 4 - Quest of the Avatar`),
   or a zip of it, to the device.
3. On the first run, choose Choose Folder and pick that folder, or Choose
   Files and pick the zip (or `ultima4.zip`).  u4upgrad.zip, disk images,
   the SMS ROM and the documents can be added then or later with the
   Files button of Graphics & Music.

## Getting started (Linux)

- **Archive:** unpack `xu4-legacy-*-linux.tar.gz` and run `./xu4` in that
  directory, or `./setup install` to install it for all users.
- **Debian & Ubuntu:** `sudo apt install ./xu4-legacy_*_amd64.deb`
  (replaces the distribution's xu4 package if installed).
- **Flatpak (any distribution):**
  `flatpak install --user xu4-legacy-*-x86_64.flatpak`, then start it from
  the menu or with `flatpak run io.github.alexdia25.xu4_legacy_edition`.
  The Freedesktop runtime is fetched from Flathub if needed.

Put the DOS game files (or `ultima4.zip`) in `~/.local/share/xu4`, or in
the directory xu4 is run from (the Flatpak only looks in
`~/.local/share/xu4`).

The source code is in `xu4-legacy-*.tar.gz`.

## What's new compared with XU4

- **Gamepad support** through SDL3.  The console style menus switch on by
  themselves when a controller is used.  In play A opens the action
  menu, X passes, Y shows Ztats, L the world map and R does the obvious
  action (changeable in Settings > Input Options > Gamepad Buttons); in
  menus A or X picks and B backs out.  Select opens the game menu and
  Start pauses.
- **Console (SMS) style menus**, also available for keyboard play under
  Settings > Legacy Edition Options: an action menu instead of one
  key per command, conversation topics that are listed as they are
  discovered, and pickers in place of typed input.
- **Documents in the game.**  The ULTIMA4.TXT file of the GOG release is
  split into the History, Book of Mystic Wisdom, Hints and Reference
  Card, which can be read from the Docs button of the Escape (Select)
  menu.
- **Apple II graphics & music.**  With the four Ultima IV Apple II disk
  images (.dsk, DOS 3.3 order) next to the game files, the Apple-II module
  shows the Apple title, intro, tiles, font, line drawn dungeons, shrine
  and ending pictures, and the Apple-II-Music soundtrack plays the
  Mockingboard tunes.  Both are read from the disks when the game runs.
  See "Apple II Disk Images" in the README.
- **Commodore 64 graphics & music.**  With the Program disk image (.d64)
  of the C64 release next to the game files, the C64 module shows the C64
  title, intro pictures, tiles, font and virtue cards, and the C64-Music
  soundtrack plays the SID tunes through the game's own music player.  The
  C64-Remastered module uses the tiles & intro art of the Ultima IV
  Remastered fan release (u4remastered.d81).  See "C64 Disk Images" in the
  README.
- **Sega Master System graphics & music.**  With the ROM of the Master
  System release (.sms) next to the game files, the SMS module shows its
  title screen, map tiles, font, story pictures, the gypsy's cards, the
  shrine visions and the endgame pictures, and the SMS-Music soundtrack
  plays its tunes through the game's own sound driver.  See "SMS ROM" in the README.
- **Mouse-only and touch play** with the console menus, using only
  taps, holds and drags.
- **World map** drawn with the chosen module's tiles, with the cloth
  map's names in runes or English, and a Runes tab in the Docs reader.
- The module browser has separate Graphics and Music sections, so any
  soundtrack can go with any graphics, and lists only modules whose game
  data is present.
- Point (pixel sharp) scaling is the default video filter.

Gamepad play has not yet been tested widely; please report problems in
the issue tracker.

No game data is included.  XU4 is licensed under the GNU GPL version 3.
